The '''K-133T''' was a model of [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] produced by [[Rark (company)|Rark]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Rark K-133T was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Game Update 3.2: Rise of the Emperor, where it is the first mount to be acquired by completing an achievement.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds]]''
